350	
   351	The historical `AffineRingGluePackage` stores only its map datum.  Consequently every
   352	projection has to elaborate the full `affineRingGlueData ...` expression again.  The
   353	presentation below retains the selected `Scheme.GlueData` and its map as one value.  It is
   354	additive: the older package and projections remain available for clients that have not yet
   355	migrated, while new clients can carry this value without reopening the gluing construction.
   356	-/
   357	
   358	/-- A chosen affine gluing and its structure map to the base scheme.
   359	
   360	The glue datum is a field rather than a repeated constructor in the type of `mapData`.  This
   361	is the important distinction for dependent consumers: changing a proof argument used to build
   362	the gluing no longer changes the type of every projection in a client file.
   363	-/
   364	structure AffineRingGluePresentation (R : Type u) [CommRing R] where
   365	  glueData : Scheme.GlueData.{u}
   366	  mapData : GluedMapData glueData (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
   367	
   368	namespace AffineRingGluePresentation
   369	
   370	/-! The constructor below is deliberately data-first.  Once a producer has selected its
   371	`Scheme.GlueData` and map datum, later consumers no longer mention the proof arguments that
   372	were used to construct them. -/
   373	
   374	/-- Package an already selected glue datum and map without re-elaborating the gluing proof. -/
   375	def ofData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   376	    (D : Scheme.GlueData.{u})
   377	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   378	    AffineRingGluePresentation R :=
   379	  { glueData := D, mapData := M }
   380	
   381	/-- Package map data while inferring its glue datum from the dependent index.
   382	
   383	This is the preferred adapter for an existing `GluedMapData`: it does not reconstruct the
   384	proof-sensitive `Scheme.GlueData` term already fixed by the type of `M`.
   385	-/
   386	def ofMapData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   387	    {D : Scheme.GlueData.{u}}
   388	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   389	    AffineRingGluePresentation R :=
   390	  { glueData := D, mapData := M }
   391	
   392	@[simp]
   393	theorem ofData_glueData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   394	    (D : Scheme.GlueData.{u})
   395	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   396	    (ofData D M).glueData = D :=
   397	  rfl
   398	
   399	@[simp]
   400	theorem ofData_mapData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   401	    (D : Scheme.GlueData.{u})
   402	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   403	    (ofData D M).mapData = M :=
   404	  rfl
   405	
   406	@[simp]
   407	theorem ofMapData_glueData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   408	    {D : Scheme.GlueData.{u}}
   409	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   410	    (ofMapData M).glueData = D :=
   411	  rfl
   412	
   413	@[simp]
   414	theorem ofMapData_mapData {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   415	    {D : Scheme.GlueData.{u}}
   416	    (M : GluedMapData D (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
   417	    (ofMapData M).mapData = M :=
   418	  rfl
   419	
   420	/-- The selected glued scheme. -/
   421	abbrev glued (P : AffineRingGluePresentation R) : Scheme.{u} := P.glueData.glued
   422	
   423	/-- The selected structure map from the glued scheme to `Spec R`. -/
   424	abbrev map (P : AffineRingGluePresentation R) : P.glueData.glued ⟶
   425	    Spec (CommRingCat.of R) := P.mapData.map
   426	
   427	@[simp]
   428	theorem chartMap_factor (P : AffineRingGluePresentation R) (i : P.glueData.J) :
   429	    P.glueData.ι i ≫ P.map = P.mapData.chartMap i :=
   430	  P.mapData.chartMap_factor i
   431	
   432	/-- Repackage a presentation as an `Over` object without reconstructing its map. -/
   433	abbrev over (P : AffineRingGluePresentation R) : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
   434	  Over.mk P.map
   435	
   436	end AffineRingGluePresentation
   437	
   438	namespace AffineRingGluePackage
   439	
   440	/-! Upgrade the legacy map-only package to the pinned presentation API. -/
   441	noncomputable def toPresentation
   442	    (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
   443	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
   444	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
   445	    (fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i))
   446	    (fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j))
   447	    (tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i))
   448	    (thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   449	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   450	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   451	    (thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   452	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   453	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))
   454	    (P : AffineRingGluePackage A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle) :
   455	    AffineRingGluePresentation R :=
   456	  AffineRingGluePresentation.ofMapData P.mapData
   457	
   458	/-! The explicit-argument adapter above is retained for source compatibility.  `pin` is the
   459	consumer-facing projection: all legacy parameters are inferred from one package value, while
   460	the result has the proof-independent `AffineRingGluePresentation` type. -/
   461	
   462	/-- Pin a legacy package once at the stable presentation boundary. -/
   463	noncomputable def pin
   464	    {A : J → Type u} {B : J → J → Type u}
   465	    [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i j, CommRing (B i j)]
   466	    [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)] [∀ i j, Algebra R (B i j)]
   467	    [∀ i j, Algebra (A i) (B i j)]
   468	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (A i) (B i j)]
   469	    {tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j}
   470	    {theta : ∀ i j k,
   471	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k}
   472	    {fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i)}
   473	    {fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j)}
   474	    {tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i)}
   475	    {thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   476	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   477	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)}
   478	    {thetaCocycle : ∀ i j k,
   479	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   480	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)}
   481	    (P : AffineRingGluePackage A B tau theta fId fOpen tauId thetaFac thetaCocycle) :
   482	    AffineRingGluePresentation R :=
   483	  AffineRingGluePresentation.ofMapData P.mapData
   484	
   485	@[simp]
   486	theorem pin_mapData
   487	    {A : J → Type u} {B : J → J → Type u}
   488	    [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i j, CommRing (B i j)]
   489	    [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)] [∀ i j, Algebra R (B i j)]
   490	    [∀ i j, Algebra (A i) (B i j)]
   491	    [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (A i) (B i j)]
   492	    {tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j}
   493	    {theta : ∀ i j k,
   494	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k}
   495	    {fId : ∀ i, IsIso (affineRestriction A B i i)}
   496	    {fOpen : ∀ i j, IsOpenImmersion (affineRestriction A B i j)}
   497	    {tauId : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i)}
   498	    {thetaFac : ∀ i j k,
   499	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
   500	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)}
